countClarification: 38 种总数由 FoodBiteRegistry 动态注册 37 种及 ModBlocks 单独注册的 3x3 冷切火腿 1 种组成。现有 11 种 PlateRegistry 取物盘不是这些直接食用大菜。

directConsumption.trigger: Right click the placed block; no empty-hand or main-hand-only condition in the source
directConsumption.eligibility: player.canEat(foodProperties.canAlwaysEat()); all 38 current bite definitions set alwaysEat=true
onSuccess: Add per-bite nutrition and saturation immediately
Roll each per-bite effect independently using source probability
Apply scaled duration with source amplifier
Play generic eat sound and emit GameEvent.EAT
Increment consumed bites by exactly one
directConsumption.afterLastBite: Keep the exhausted block at bites=max; next interaction destroys it and produces source container/extra drops

quality.sourceBiteSaturationModifier: baseSaturationModifier * ratio; FoodData.eat computes 2 * scaledNutrition * scaledModifier and caps saturation to food level
quality.placement: 1x1 and 1x2 copy source item quality into block state; old untagged items use4
quality.threeByThreeException: getStateForPlacement overrides the parent and returns default state plus facing only; the fixed source does not copy held quality for cold_cut_ham_slices
quality.intactBreak: bites=0 restores quality on dropped FoodBiteBlock item; any consumed state only yields containers/extras
quality.pluginPolicyBoundary: Keep existing kitchen quality rules. FoodDefinition.scaled currently scales stored absolute saturation linearly and clamps positive nutrition to at least1; it is not mathematically identical to the source per-bite modifier formula. Document or implement a dedicated placed-bite policy without changing old items.

loot.unbitten: Exactly one whole source dish, with quality where applicable
loot.anyConsumedBite: Only declared container and extras; never recover remaining edible portions or full dish
loot.explosion: Each source pool has survives_explosion condition

wholeItemConsumption.sourceBehavior: BowlFoodBlockItem consumes full-item food and returns exhausted-block loot, including flower pots and extra materials
wholeItemConsumption.currentGap: Current food PDC has a single container (bowl for these catalogued items); the existing consumption listener cannot represent every source extra drop or replace bowl with flower pot using that field alone
wholeItemConsumption.specialColdCutHam: LiftBlockItem is not edible in hand; place its 3x3 dish to eat

comparator.boundary: For dishes with more than3 bites this source formula becomes negative; do not silently call a normalized/clamped replacement exact parity

1x1.support: FoodBlock does not add a custom support-survival check

1x2.owner: RIGHT position1 at clicked block; LEFT position0 at facing.clockwise
1x2.placement: Check left neighbor replaceability before placing, then create matching second half
1x2.synchronization: Relevant side neighbor with same block/facing/opposite position copies bites; missing/mismatched mate removes this half
1x2.dropOwner: RIGHT only; LEFT getDrops returns empty
1x2.creativeBreak: Breaking LEFT explicitly removes RIGHT with suppress-drops

3x3.owner: CENTER at clicked block; only center has block entity and loot
3x3.placement: All9 cells must be replaceable; offsets map to NinePart independently of facing
3x3.interaction: Any part resolves center; only center bite count changes
3x3.breakAndExplosion: handleRemove resolves center, destroys center once, clears eight parts with suppress-drops
3x3.missingOwner: Source handleRemove returns if center block entity absent; orphan repair is a plugin improvement requiring explicit scope
3x3.visuals: Java model eight food parts, base persists; bite8 hidden first, then7..1. JSON empty selector alone cannot provide nine stages.

POT_SOUP_ANIMATE_TICK.vanillaReplacement: Existing resource/vanilla steam approximation; vanilla cannot register a mod particle type

animations.timingBoundary: Client animateTick sampling is not a 20Hz server tick; bounded server emission near tracked players is an explicit approximation

proposedPluginPath.preferredOperation: Direct player hunger/effect transaction, not giving a bite item
whyNotBiteItem: Adds a delayed portable consumable and inventory capacity condition absent upstream
Runs PlayerItemConsumeEvent instead of placed-block interaction
Changes probability timing, partial-dish destruction and item/container conservation
steps: Resolve full owner/part set and immutable per-bite definition/quality snapshot
Require player and all touched blocks owned by current Folia region; deny cross-region transaction until a dedicated protocol exists
Check protection and cancelled interaction; acquire per-owner transfer guard
Raise cancellable FoodLevelChangeEvent with prospective food level and source item context; do not invoke PlayerItemConsumeEvent for an item that is not being consumed
After callbacks, recheck owner/version/bites/player availability; commit one bite and mark save before externally observable effect/drop callbacks
Apply final allowed food level and bounded saturation, apply vanilla and custom effects once, then sound and GameEvent.EAT
At max bites keep empty visual; next click uses cancelable break/protection path and single loot owner

eventAndApiMapping.notes: Honor useInteractedBlock cancellation; off-hand dedupe policy must be explicit
Local CraftHumanEntity setters directly assign FoodData fields; they do not emit FoodLevelChangeEvent. Event must precede mutation.
FOOD cause enum exists; public addPotionEffect has no cause argument in local API. Cause-preserving path needs versioned bridge or documented PLUGIN-cause difference, not a second fake event.
Own player entity scheduler required; existing CookeryConsumeListener.apply skips all vanilla effects and cannot alone implement direct consumption
API presence does not prove CE multi-cell placement emits the right event; verify at runtime
One owner computes intact-versus-used loot; suppress duplicate base CE loot
Respect affected-list edits and source explosion survival; remove parts once
Calling the event alone does not emit vibration; sendGameEvent is the emission API
Public API signatures checked locally; no cross-region runtime acceptance

proposedPluginPath.collisionBoundary: Vanilla clients use vanilla block collision shapes. CE tripwire/display entities can show source meshes but cannot make arbitrary mod voxel collision exact.

acceptanceRequired: Source38/catalog38/CE38 registrations and every state/model dependency
Full and hungry player conditions, blocked interaction/food/effect callbacks and reentry
Each quality and probability/duration boundary without modifying old kitchen scaling
Intact break versus one-bite/empty break, duplicated extra items and source explosion condition
1x2 both halves and 3x3 all9 parts: placement rollback/break/explosion/orphan/reload
Restart/unload, concurrent users, protected areas and Folia region boundary
Vanilla client resource reception, states, particles and documented collision differences

blockstate.renderer: Java ColdCutHamSlicesModel; nine visibility stages required

limitations: Research only; no new gameplay code, runtime test or client acceptance added
Local API signatures prove available entrypoints, not event ordering or CE integration behavior
Counts refer to the named immutable CE ZIP, not live players or production servers
